title: Best Practices in EEG Analysis: Preprocessing, Modeling, and Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis requires careful choices in preprocessing, statistical modeling, and machine learning because EEG signals are highly susceptible to artifacts, volume conduction, low signal-to-noise ratio, and substantial inter-subject variability. This chapter provides a practical and methodological guide to modern EEG analysis, spanning EEG preprocessing, artifact removal, filtering, bad-channel detection and interpolation, re-referencing, independent component analysis (ICA), and preprocessing of simultaneous EEG-fMRI recordings. We review major approaches for computational EEG analysis, including event-related potentials (ERPs), time-frequency analysis, functional and effective connectivity, source localization, multivariate decoding, permutation testing, and multiple-comparison correction. translated_title: 脑电图分析的最佳实践：预处理、建模与机器学习
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）分析需要在预处理、统计建模和机器学习方面做出审慎的选择，因为脑电信号极易受到伪影、容积传导、低信噪比以及显著的被试间差异的影响。本章为现代脑电图分析提供了一份实用且系统的方法学指南，内容涵盖脑电预处理、伪影去除、滤波、坏通道检测与插值、重参考、独立成分分析（ICA）以及同步脑电-功能磁共振（EEG-fMRI）记录的预处理。我们回顾了计算脑电分析的主要方法，包括事件相关电位（ERP）、时频分析、功能连接与有效连接、源定位、多变量解码、置换检验以及多重比较校正。随后，我们探讨了脑电的机器学习方法，从基于特征的分类器到深度学习以及新兴的脑电基础模型。
tldr: 本章系统总结了现代脑电图分析的完整方法学最佳实践，涵盖从预处理、伪影去除、计算分析到机器学习（包括深度学习与新兴脑电基础模型）的全流程方法指南。
en_tdlr: This chapter provides a comprehensive methodological guide to best practices in modern EEG analysis, covering the full pipeline from preprocessing, artifact removal, and computational analysis to machine learning approaches ranging from feature-based classifiers to deep learning and emerging EEG foundation models.
